display.purpose: Weights, reps, timers — extrabold tabular figures.

body.purpose: Default UI copy; rem-based for a11y scaling.

label.purpose: Small-caps muted labels above card groups.

shadows.name: card-tint-lift
shadows.value: inset 0 1px 0 var(--sheen-edge), 0 12px 32px -18px color-mix(in srgb, var(--tint) 50%, transparent)

shadows.name: primary-glow
shadows.value: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.35), 0 10px 28px -10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--grad-a) 65%, transparent)

motion.name: ease-bounce
motion.purpose: Press release spring; real linear() spring where supported.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Tactile squash on press; primary stretches.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One primary per screen — blue→violet gradient with dark ink.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: Inter, Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; padding: 12px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 1rem; cursor: pointer; color: #06122a; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5b9cff 0%, #7f8bff 55%, #9b86ff 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.35), 0 10px 28px -10px rgb(91 156 255 / 0.65); transition: transform 460ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(1.02, 0.9); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.25), 0 4px 14px -8px rgb(91 156 255 / 0.6); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4c8dff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary raised control with hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: Inter, Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 1rem; cursor: pointer; color: #eef2f7; background: #18202b; border: 1px solid #232d3a; transition: border-color 150ms ease, transform 460ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgb(76 141 255 / 0.4); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4c8dff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Raised glass tile — hairline, top sheen, soft lift.
components.html:
Today's workout

Push · 48 min · plates matched to your gym
components.css: .ds-card { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.03), transparent 40%), #10151d; border: 1px solid #232d3a; border-radius: 20px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05), 0 8px 24px -16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6); color: #eef2f7; font-family: Inter, Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.5; color: #94a1b2; }

components.name: Pick Chip
components.description: Filter / feel chip; selected state adds accent wash and tick cue.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; font-family: Inter, Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #232d3a; background: #18202b; color: #eef2f7; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: rgb(76 141 255 / 0.4); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4c8dff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-active { background: color-mix(in srgb, #4c8dff 22%, transparent); border-color: #4c8dff; } .ds-chip-tick { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #4c8dff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #06122a; }

components.name: Number Field
components.description: Bump-style numeric field: minus, value, plus — gym-floor default.
components.css: .ds-bump { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: Inter, Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-bump-btn { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 1rem; border: 1px solid #232d3a; background: #18202b; color: #eef2f7; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 70ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-bump-btn:hover { border-color: rgb(76 141 255 / 0.4); } .ds-bump-btn:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-bump-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4c8dff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-bump-input { width: 5.5rem; height: 44px; text-align: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: #eef2f7; background: #18202b; border: 1px solid #232d3a; border-radius: 1rem; } .ds-bump-input:focus { outline: 2px solid #4c8dff; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #4c8dff; }

components.name: Switch
components.description: On/off switch — thumb springs across; never On/Off chip pairs.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 52px; height: 32px; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: #4c8dff; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4c8dff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-switch-thumb { position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 24px; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 999px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35); transition: left 200ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); } .ds-switch[aria-checked="false"] { background: #232d3a; } .ds-switch[aria-checked="false"] .ds-switch-thumb { left: 4px; }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Five-tab phone navigation with accent active state.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabbar" aria-label="Main"><button class="ds-tab ds-tab-active" type="button">Today</button><button class="ds-tab" type="button">Body</button><button class="ds-tab" type="button">Progress</button><button class="ds-tab" type="button">Friends</button><button class="ds-tab" type="button">Awards</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 10px calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); background: #10151d; border-top: 1px solid #232d3a; font-family: Inter, Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; min-height: 44px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: #94a1b2; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #eef2f7; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4c8dff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab-active { color: #4c8dff; background: color-mix(in srgb, #4c8dff 14%, transparent); }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: Small-caps muted label above a card group.
components.html:
This week

3 of 4 sessions done
components.css: .ds-section { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: Inter, Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-section-label { margin: 0; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #94a1b2; } .ds-card { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.03), transparent 40%), #10151d; border: 1px solid #232d3a; border-radius: 20px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05), 0 8px 24px -16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6); color: #eef2f7; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.5; color: #94a1b2; }

narrative.overview:
Liftsmith looks like a dark, trustworthy forge for serious lifting: deep navy-black surfaces, one Trust Cobalt accent, and raised glass cards under a soft top aurora. The system is professional and calm on the gym floor — lively in small springs and bursts, never loud mid-set. Brand lives in precise tokens, tabular numbers, and a single primary action per screen.

Personality is dark-default, tactile glass, and restrained craft. Supporting hues (Forge Violet, Rest Cyan, Ember, Done Mint) tint marks and cards; they never become body text. Status colours (mint / amber / coral) keep their meaning. Light mode keeps the same structure with deeper cobalt for contrast. Accessibility is part of the identity: WCAG 2.2 AA, colour-blind safe tokens, Lean mode, and rem-based type.

Confirmed visual rejections: competitor fitness-app skins; purple-on-white SaaS gradients; cream-serif “wellness brochure”; emoji chrome; loud gamification neon on core workout UI.
keyCharacteristics: Dark navy forge base with Trust Cobalt as the rare accent
Blue→violet primary gradient; one primary per screen
Raised glass cards (20px) with hairline + top sheen
System sans (Inter / Roboto); extrabold screen titles; tabular display numbers
Soft glass lift + aurora glow; motion short and purposeful (none during a set except what was touched)

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Trust Cobalt (and its gradient) is the only brand accent on a screen; supporting hues are tints for marks and card glows, never body copy.

rules.name: The Status Means Status Rule
rules.body: Mint, amber, and coral communicate recovery and feedback only — never pure decoration on core workout chrome.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a CSS variable in globals.css with dark and light values; never hard-code a hex in a component.

rules.name: The One Title Scale Rule
rules.body: Never invent heading sizes by hand — use ScreenHeader, Section, Sheet, or the shared title classes.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any weight, rep, timer, or readiness figure uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The No Touching Cards Rule
rules.body: Two bordered rounded surfaces never sit closer than a visible gap (CI e2e-gaps.mjs).

rules.name: The One Primary Rule
rules.body: Exactly one primary action per screen.

rules.name: The Soft Glass Rule
rules.body: Prefer hairline + sheen + short shadow over large multi-layer drop shadows.

rules.name: The Calm Motion Rule
rules.body: Springs and bursts are short; Lean mode and prefers-reduced-motion cut them. Nothing moves during a set except what the lifter just touched.

rules.name: The Glass Tile Rule
rules.body: Cards are rounded rectangles with sheen — not floating opaque blobs or hard Material cards.

dos: Do use CSS tokens from globals.css for every colour, including status and CVD variants.
Do put screen titles through ScreenHeader / SCREEN_TITLE and section labels through Section.
Do keep one primary gradient button per screen and gap every card stack.
Do prefer steppers, chips, and switches over typing on the gym floor.
Do honour dark default, light theme, colour-blind safe, and more-contrast modes.
donts: Don't hard-code hex colours in components.
Don't use competitor names, art, or look-alikes; don't put emoji in app chrome.
Don't add a second control that opens the same sheet/page already reachable on that screen.
Don't animate for decoration during a set, or stretch desktop side-page buttons past 25rem.
Don't invent purple-on-white, cream-serif wellness, or neon gamification for core workout UI.
